effects: Sets the signer's wstETH allowance for `spender` to exactly `amount`, replacing any earlier allowance (ERC20Upgradeable.approve -> _approve(owner, spender, amount)).
No tokens move and no native value is taken (not payable).
formats.shown: Intent 'Authorize spending', sentence 'Allow to spend {amount}', and fields Spender (address) and Amount in wstETH with an 'Unlimited' threshold.

findings.title: approve sentence 'Allow to spend {amount}' leaves out the spender who receives the allowance.
findings.evidence: descriptor approve format: "interpolatedIntent": "Allow to spend {amount}"; the Spender field (#.spender) is shown but not in the sentence. Case 0 renders 'Allow to spend 0.000038378207743609 wstETH' with no spender. ERC20Upgradeable.approve: _approve(owner, spender, amount).

cases.notes: The approval of 38378207743609 wei wstETH to 0x1111...2a65 matches the Spender and Amount fields. The sentence omits the spender, but the field shows it. The reader got it right.

effects: Sends `amount` wstETH from the signer to `to` (ERC20Upgradeable.transfer -> _transfer(owner, to, amount)); there is no fee or burn.
No native value is taken (not payable).
formats.shown: Intent 'Transfer wstETH', sentence 'Send {amount} to {to}', and fields Recipient and Amount in wstETH.

cases.notes: 0.352705684561495844 wstETH leaves for 0xFE85...8A0f, exactly as shown. The reader got it right.

formats.key: transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount)
effects: Moves `amount` wstETH from `from` to `to` (ERC20Upgradeable.transferFrom -> _transfer(from, to, amount)).
Spends `amount` of the allowance that `from` gave the signer, unless that allowance is type(uint256).max (_spendAllowance).
No native value is taken (not payable).
formats.shown: Intent 'Transfer wstETH', sentence 'Send {amount} to {to}', and fields Sender, Recipient and Amount in wstETH.

findings.title: transferFrom sentence 'Send {amount} to {to}' omits the source address and reads as the signer sending.
findings.evidence: descriptor transferFrom format: "interpolatedIntent": "Send {amount} to {to}". Case 2 renders 'Send 0.113492582574591644 wstETH to 0x2aeD...1597', while the tokens leave 0x08b0...1e65 (field Sender). ERC20Upgradeable.transferFrom: _spendAllowance(from, spender, amount); _transfer(from, to, amount).

findings.title: transferFrom does not say that it uses up the allowance `from` gave the signer.
findings.evidence: ERC20Upgradeable._spendAllowance: if (currentAllowance != type(uint256).max) { _approve(owner, spender, currentAllowance - amount); }. No field or intent mentions the allowance.
findings.fix: Optionally change the intent to 'Transfer wstETH using allowance'.
